# The Free Dictionary
> A comprehensive free reference site combining dictionaries, thesaurus, encyclopedia, idioms, acronyms, and specialized legal, medical, and financial resources.

The Free Dictionary by Farlex provides multilingual dictionaries, topic encyclopedias, language-learning tools, and daily editorial features. It also offers specialized reference content for medicine, law, finance, computing, and literature, plus help pages and webmaster tools.

## Core Reference
- [Home](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): Main portal to dictionary, thesaurus, encyclopedia, and daily reference features.
- [Dictionary](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): English dictionary with definitions, pronunciation, usage, and example entries.
- [Thesaurus](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/thesaurus): Synonyms, antonyms, and related words for English terms.
- [Encyclopedia](https://encyclopedia.thefreedictionary.com/): General encyclopedia articles on people, places, science, history, and culture.
- [Idioms](https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/): Idiom and phrase dictionary with meanings and usage explanations.
- [Acronyms and Abbreviations](https://acronyms.thefreedictionary.com/): Expanded forms and meanings for abbreviations across many domains.
- [Wikipedia Encyclopedia](https://encyclopedia2.thefreedictionary.com/): Mirror-style encyclopedia content sourced from Wikipedia articles.
- [Computing Dictionary](https://computing-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Definitions for computing, software, internet, and technical terminology.

## Specialized Dictionaries
- [Medical Dictionary](https://medical-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Medical terminology, diseases, procedures, anatomy, and healthcare reference entries.
- [Legal Dictionary](https://legal-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Legal terms, concepts, case-related vocabulary, and law reference material.
- [Financial Dictionary](https://financial-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Finance, investing, accounting, banking, and business terminology definitions.
- [Farlex Partner Medical Dictionary](https://medical-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Specialized medical reference for clinicians, students, and health readers.
- [Farlex Financial Dictionary](https://financial-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Business and finance reference covering markets, instruments, and accounting terms.
- [Farlex Legal Dictionary](https://legal-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/): Legal reference for statutes, procedures, rights, and legal vocabulary.
- [Columbia Encyclopedia](https://encyclopedia.thefreedictionary.com/Columbia+Encyclopedia): Encyclopedia source page for Columbia Encyclopedia content.
- [Literature Reference Library](https://encyclopedia.thefreedictionary.com/literature): Literature-focused reference articles, authors, works, and criticism.

## Multilingual Dictionaries
- [Spanish Dictionary](https://es.thefreedictionary.com/): Spanish-language dictionary and bilingual reference resources.
- [German Dictionary](https://de.thefreedictionary.com/): German-language dictionary and translation-oriented reference tools.
- [French Dictionary](https://fr.thefreedictionary.com/): French-language dictionary with definitions and language reference content.
- [Italian Dictionary](https://it.thefreedictionary.com/): Italian-language dictionary and lexical reference resources.
- [Chinese Dictionary](https://zh.thefreedictionary.com/): Chinese-language dictionary and multilingual lookup tools.
- [Portuguese Dictionary](https://pt.thefreedictionary.com/): Portuguese-language dictionary and word reference content.
- [Dutch Dictionary](https://nl.thefreedictionary.com/): Dutch-language dictionary and lexical reference pages.
- [Russian Dictionary](https://ru.thefreedictionary.com/): Russian-language dictionary and multilingual reference tools.

## Language Tools
- [Word Finder](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/word-finder): Tool for finding words by pattern, length, or letters.
- [Grammar](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/grammar.htm): Grammar lessons and explanations for English usage and structure.
- [Word of the Day](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/word-of-the-day.htm): Daily featured word with definition, pronunciation, and examples.
- [Article of the Day](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/article-of-the-day.htm): Daily featured encyclopedia-style article on notable topics.
- [This Day in History](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/this-day-in-history.htm): Daily historical events and anniversaries.
- [Today's Birthday](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/todays-birthday.htm): Daily biographies of notable people born on the current date.
- [Quotation of the Day](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/quote-of-the-day.htm): Daily quotation with source attribution.
- [Spelling Bee](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/Spelling-Bee.htm): Word game focused on spelling and vocabulary practice.

## Browse and Discovery
- [A–Z](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/alpha.htm): Alphabetical browsing index for dictionary and reference entries.
- [Browse Dictionary](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/browse.htm): Browse words and entries alphabetically across the site.
- [Recent Searches](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): Homepage area showing recently searched terms and topics.
- [Live Searches](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): Homepage feature displaying terms being searched in real time.
- [What's Inside](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): Overview of included dictionaries, encyclopedias, and reference collections.
- [Search](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/search.aspx?tab=1): Search interface for dictionary and related reference content.
- [Search by Encyclopedia](https://encyclopedia.thefreedictionary.com/): Search encyclopedia articles by topic or title.
- [Browse Idioms](https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/): Explore idioms and phrases alphabetically.

## Help and Site Features
- [Help: Homepage](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/help/help2.htm): Explains homepage modules, customization, and daily content features.
- [Help Index](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/help/help1.htm): Main help page for using site tools and features.
- [Customize Your Homepage](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): Personalize homepage modules, layout, and displayed content.
- [For Surfers](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): User-facing tools and features for readers and learners.
- [For Webmasters](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Webmaster resources including linking tools and site integration options.
- [Add to Browser Search](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/): Instructions and options for browser-integrated search access.
- [Mobile](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/mobile.htm): Information about mobile access and apps for The Free Dictionary.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/privacy-policy.htm): Privacy practices and data handling information.

## Daily and Archive Content
- [Archive](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/archive.htm): Archive of daily words, articles, birthdays, and historical features.
- [Word of the Day Archive](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/word-of-the-day.htm): Current and linked historical daily word entries.
- [Article of the Day Archive](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/article-of-the-day.htm): Current article page with access to archived daily articles.
- [This Day in History Archive](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/this-day-in-history.htm): Historical daily feature with links to prior dates.
- [Today's Birthday Archive](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/todays-birthday.htm): Daily birthday feature with archived notable biographies.
- [Daily Grammar Lesson](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/grammar.htm): Ongoing grammar feature highlighted from the homepage.
- [Quotation of the Day Archive](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/quote-of-the-day.htm): Daily quotation feature with prior entries.
- [Daily Calendar Features](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/archive.htm): Central archive for recurring daily editorial content.

## Webmaster and Integrations
- [Webmasters](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Tools and widgets for adding dictionary content to external sites.
- [Free Dictionary Lookup Box](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Search box integration for websites and blogs.
- [Content Links](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Linking options for dictionary and reference pages.
- [Word of the Day Widget](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Embeddable daily word feature for third-party sites.
- [Article of the Day Widget](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Embeddable daily article feature for websites.
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/webmasters.htm): Feed options for daily words and other recurring content.
